items: Location pages usually fail to rank because of thin templated content, missing schema markup, unclear URLs and weak internal linking, which leaves Google with few local signals.
Give each page unique local content, consistent name, address and phone details, hours, an embedded map, local photos, reviews and clear calls to action like Get Directions.
To scale across many locations, use a smart template with dynamic fields, automate schema and metadata from your location database, and keep details in sync with Google Business Profiles.
Link every location page from your homepage, store finder, nearby locations and relevant city content so search engines and customers can find it.
Track organic traffic, near me impressions, direction clicks, calls and store-level revenue for each page to see which locations need more work.
